comparison.objective: Fit a long wardrobe rail into closed and open end supports under a shelf.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual long-part tilt or swing insertion in constrained clearance.
comparison.success_condition: Both ends seated, rail level, released, and still for one second.
comparison.reason: Constrained long-part insertion is meaningfully different from counterholding an angular adjustment during locknut tightening.
